funeralLines.t: 🕯️ Ines's funeral feast: 3,000 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Stonebridge, Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
